Breads and Breakfasts 371
PROTEIN-PACKED SCRAMBLED EGGS
Adding cottage cheese to eggs is a simple way to boost your morning pro-
tein. Plus, it makes the eggs creamy and yummier. You can use a blender
to mix the ingredients, but honestly, no one will care if there’s a curd of
cottage cheese in the eggs; it just looks like egg white! Of course, you
can be creative and add sauteed veggies and shredded low-fat cheddar
cheese. Serve with whole-grain toast, oatmeal, (microwaved) sweet potato,
or another source of carbohydrate to fill up your muscle glycogen stores.
Recipe courtesy of Judith Scharman Draughon, MSN, RDN, LD, author
of Lean Body Smart Life.
2 eggs
1/4 cup (spoonful) cottage cheese
Optional: 1/4 cup (30 g) grated (reduced-fat cheddar) cheese,
sauteed onion, peppers, spinach
Yield: 1 serving
NUTRITION INFORMATION: 175 total calories; 3 g carbohydrate; 19 g protein; 10 g fat
